speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation. I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting as a newborn with respiratory distress; please tell me your gestational age and whether you were delivered via cesarean section. Also, has your mother had any recent infections or been exposed to rubella or chickenpox?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

Thank you for the information; your prematurity and C-section delivery are significant risk factors. Given your mother's healthy status regarding infections, I suspect lung immaturity. REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
